partnerp.sign_in_lead: For university staff who publish programs and scholarships with GEC.
partnerp.login_link: Are you a university? Partner sign-in
partnerp.dash_lead: Publish your programs and scholarships to students across the region. Every change is reviewed by GEC before it goes live.
partnerp.agreement_hint: Individual programs can carry their own agreed rate. Contact your GEC partnership manager to change it.
partnerp.agreement_none: Your agreement is being set up by GEC.
partnerp.no_applications: No applications from GEC students yet.
partnerp.how_1: Add or edit a program, a scholarship or your university profile and submit it.
partnerp.how_2: GEC's admissions team reviews the change (usually within two working days) and may ask for edits.
partnerp.how_3: Once approved it appears on the GEC website and in student matching straight away.
partnerp.list_lead: Changes you submit are reviewed by GEC before they appear on the website.
partnerp.empty_program: No programs yet — add your first one.
partnerp.empty_scholarship: No scholarships yet — add your first one.
partnerp.form_lead: Fill in what students need to decide. Arabic fields are optional but help students in the region.
partnerp.open_hint: you already have a change waiting for review; submitting again replaces it.
partnerp.submitted: Submitted. GEC will review it and let you know by e-mail.
partnerp.image_submitted: Image uploaded and added to your profile changes for review.
partnerp.profile_lead: Keep your description, admission details and images up to date.
partnerp.images_hint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 8 MB. Use a landscape campus photo (at least 1600 px wide) and a square logo.
partnerp.subs_lead: Everything your team has submitted and GEC's decision.
partnerp.apps_lead: Students GEC has applied to your university for and where each application stands.
partnerp.apps_privacy: Only the details needed to process the application are shown here; documents are shared through the usual admissions channel.
partnerp.team_lead: People at your university who can use this portal.
partnerp.invited: Invitation sent. The link to set a password is valid for a limited time.
partnerp.commission_hint: GEC's margin for students enrolled on this program. Leave on the university agreement unless a different rate was agreed.
partnerp.mail_invite_body:
Hello {name},

You have been given access to the GEC partner portal for {university}. Use it to publish programs and scholarships and follow the applications GEC sends you.

Set your password with the button below.
partnerp.mail_approved_body: "{name}" was approved and is now published on the GEC website.
partnerp.mail_changes_requested_body: GEC reviewed "{name}" and asked for a few changes before publishing:
partnerp.mail_rejected_body: GEC could not publish "{name}". The reason:
partnerp.requests_lead: Universities that asked to join from the website. Approving opens a partnership, sets GEC's margin and invites the contact to the portal.
partnerp.approve_hint: Link the request to a university already in the catalogue or create a new (hidden) record, then set the commission GEC earns per enrolled student.
partnerp.gec_margin_hint: Percent of first-year tuition, or a fixed amount per enrolled student.
partnerp.queue_lead: Programs, scholarships and profile changes submitted by partner universities. Nothing is published until you approve it.
partnerp.diff_hint: Highlighted rows are what the university changed.
partnerp.note_hint: Required when asking for changes or declining; sent by e-mail.
partnerp.sub_changes_requested: Sent back to the university for changes.
partnerp.accounts_lead: University staff with access to the partner portal.
partnerp.invite_hint: They receive an e-mail to set a password and can then publish for their university only.
partnerp.public_title: Reach motivated students across the Middle East
partnerp.public_lead: Partner with GEC to publish your programs and scholarships, receive complete, pre-checked applications and follow every student from enquiry to enrolment.
partnerp.why_lead: A counselling team that knows your entry requirements, and a portal your staff can update themselves.

why.reach_d: Students are counselled and matched on grades, English and budget before they apply.
why.portal_d: Your team publishes programs, scholarships, deadlines and photos directly.
why.quality_d: Documents are verified and complete before they reach your admissions office.
why.insight_d: See every application GEC submits and where it stands.

partnerp.step1_d: Tell us about your university below.
partnerp.step2_d: Our partnerships team agrees the commission and the programs to promote.
partnerp.step3_d: Your staff receive accounts to publish and update content.
partnerp.step4_d: We counsel, apply and follow students through to enrolment.
partnerp.f_message: Anything we should know (programs, intakes, existing agreements)
partnerp.form_sent: Thank you — your request has reached our partnerships team. We will reply by e-mail within two working days.
partnerp.margin_text: GEC is paid a commission per enrolled student, agreed with you in advance — a percentage of first-year tuition or a fixed amount, and it can differ per program. Students never pay GEC for your programs.
partnerp.review_text: Everything your team publishes is reviewed by GEC's admissions team before it goes live, so students always see accurate information.
